technique_name: Imagine that the year is 2040 and describe a typical day.
description: In 2040, a typical day begins with a sunrise virtual reality experience before stepping into an automated shower and getting dressed in a self-cleaning fabric outfit. After breakfast, commuting consists of hopping into a self-driving car or flying an autonomous drone to work. At work, meetings are held via holographic technology, and lunch is often spent catching up with neighbours or relatives living in other parts of the world via augmented reality video conference.
